_readme: Manual QB override file -- highest precedence over every automated source (depth charts, ESPN, modal starters). Edit, commit, push; the next odds-watch run picks it up. NFL keys are nflverse abbreviations (KC, DET); CFB keys are ratings-table school names (Ohio State, Toledo). 'starter' corrects who QB1 is; 'alert' forces a QB-uncertainty flag onto that team's card with your reason shown verbatim. Delete an entry when resolved. Empty objects = no overrides.
